description: This file defines the SpriteTextActivity class, which is an Android activity responsible for setting up an OpenGL ES rendering context for sprite text graphics. It initializes a GLSurfaceView, assigns a GLWrapper for custom GL wrapping, and sets a renderer that handles sprite text rendering.

classes.name: SpriteTextActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that manages an OpenGL ES surface for sprite text rendering, handling lifecycle events to pause and resume rendering appropriately.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the GLSurfaceView, sets up a custom GLWrapper, and assigns the SpriteTextRenderer for rendering.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Pauses the GLSurfaceView rendering when the activity is paused.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Resumes the GLSurfaceView rendering when the activity regains focus.
